Target audience: Undergraduate students in STEM

Section: section_1 — Intuitive Hook: The Viewpoint Shift

Lecture lines:
Same vector, different observers.
GPS vs local hiker coordinates.
Think of a cat on a rug.

Planned animations:
Fade in camera perspective shifting #FFFFFF.
Display 2D points transitioning between frames #FFD700.
Highlight the relative coordinate difference #00FF00.

Section: section_2 — Prerequisite Review: Basis as Building Blocks

Lecture lines:
Basis vectors are simple building blocks.
Standard grid lines become skewed.
Skewed grids represent new basis vectors.

Planned animations:
Show vector space basis vectors #FF4500.
Animate vector spanning combination #1E90FF.
Label origin and basis vectors clearly #FFFFFF.

Section: section_3 — The Change of Basis Matrix (P)

Lecture lines:
Change of basis needs a translator.
Matrix P holds new basis vectors.
Old coordinates equal P times new.
Use P to bridge perspectives.
The translator bridges coordinate systems.

Planned animations:
Introduce matrix P as transformation #FF8C00.
Show matrix column concatenation #ADFF2F.
Indicate inverse transformation flow #FF1493.

Section: section_4 — Practical Application: Coordinate Conversion

Lecture lines:
Finding new coordinates requires matrix inversion.
Inverse P un-skews the grid.
Drone navigation uses this conversion.
Back to global latitude/longitude.
Calculate coordinates using inverse P.

Planned animations:
Set up input vector coordinates #FFFFFF.
Perform matrix multiplication visually #FFFF00.
Highlight final converted position #7FFF00.

Section: section_5 — Summary & Geometric Intuition

Lecture lines:
Perspective shift, not vector movement.
Language changes, the object remains.
Everything is a coordinate transformation.

Planned animations:
Consolidate all matrices into unified frame #FFFFFF.
Link geometric intuition to coordinate values #FFD700.
Final review of transformation mapping #00CED1.

    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE

        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")

        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        self.wait(1)
